  • Method Details

    • getCode

      MetroCode getCode()
      Returns:
      the metro code as a MetroCode enum, or MetroCode.UNKNOWN for a metro this SDK's enum does not list; use metroId() for the exact code of an unlisted metro

    • metroId

      MetroId metroId()
      Returns:
      the metro's code as a forward-compatible MetroId, preserving the exact value even for metros absent from MetroCode

      String getCountry()

    • getEquinixAsn

      Long getEquinixAsn()
      Returns:
      the Equinix autonomous system number (ASN) for this Fabric metro

    • getLocalVCBandwidthMax

      Long getLocalVCBandwidthMax()
      Returns:
      the maximum local (intra-metro) virtual-connection bandwidth in Mbps

    • getServices

      List<MetroService> getServices()
      Returns:
      the service types supported in this metro (e.g. ETHERNET_IP_SERVICE, TIME_SERVICE)

    • getGeoScopes

      List<GeoScopeType> getGeoScopes()
      Returns:
      the geographic boundaries this metro supports (e.g. CONUS, EU)

    • getGeoZones

      Returns:
